dedupe_keys.name: season access metro reference network topology telefonica and telecom italia

description: This dataset gives a reference topology of a metro-regional optical network, inspired by real networks designed by the Telefónica group, together with four realistic access network topology geotypes (dense urban, urban, suburban and rural) prepared by Telecom Italia, both produced in the European SEASON project on high-capacity optical networks. Mapping the access geotypes onto the metro-regional nodes gives a complete description of the metro and access segments, with nodes, links, distances and aggregation levels, for networking and techno-economic studies. Coverage: a synthetic but realistic regional network of a European operator, not a specific place; version 2 published on Zenodo on 23 September 2025. Format and access: five XLSX workbooks and a PPTX explanation (about 2.3 MB) on Zenodo, free to download under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. Caveats: reference topologies are stylised and anonymised; traffic matrices and equipment costs are not included; operators' real networks differ. Simulation uses: a benchmark network for capacity planning, routing and protection optimisation, and resilience analysis of metro and access networks under link or node failures. Related records: the Telefónica reference packet optical topology covers edge to core, SNDlib and T-Garden give backbone topologies.
